therapeutic_areas.description_zh: 癌症治疗，全球研发与销售最集中的领域，涵盖免疫检查点、靶向、ADC、细胞治疗等。
therapeutic_areas.description_en: Cancer therapeutics — the largest concentration of global R&D and sales, spanning checkpoint inhibitors, targeted therapy, ADCs and cell therapy.

therapeutic_areas.description_zh: 自身免疫与炎症性疾病（类风湿、银屑病、IBD、特应性皮炎等），TNF/IL 抑制剂的主战场。
therapeutic_areas.description_en: Autoimmune and inflammatory disease (rheumatoid arthritis, psoriasis, IBD, atopic dermatitis); the home of TNF/IL inhibitors.

therapeutic_areas.description_zh: 中枢神经系统疾病：阿尔茨海默、帕金森、多发性硬化、抑郁、SMA 等，难度高、未满足需求大。
therapeutic_areas.description_en: Central-nervous-system disease: Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, multiple sclerosis, depression, SMA — high difficulty, large unmet need.

therapeutic_areas.description_zh: 心血管、糖尿病、肥胖、血脂等代谢疾病；GLP-1 减重药正重塑该领域格局。
therapeutic_areas.description_en: Cardiovascular, diabetes, obesity and lipid disease; GLP-1 weight-loss drugs are reshaping the field.

therapeutic_areas.description_zh: 抗病毒、抗菌、抗真菌及 HIV/HCV 等治疗，疫情驱动周期性高峰。
therapeutic_areas.description_en: Antivirals, antibacterials, antifungals and HIV/HCV therapy; pandemic-driven cyclical peaks.

therapeutic_areas.description_zh: 预防性与治疗性疫苗，mRNA/亚单位/灭活/病毒载体多平台并存。
therapeutic_areas.description_en: Prophylactic and therapeutic vaccines across mRNA, subunit, inactivated and viral-vector platforms.

therapeutic_areas.description_zh: 孤儿药领域，多为单基因病的酶替代、基因/细胞治疗，定价高、政策激励强。
therapeutic_areas.description_en: Orphan-drug space — enzyme replacement, gene/cell therapy for mostly monogenic disease; high pricing, strong policy incentives.

therapeutic_areas.description_zh: 眼底病（湿性 AMD、糖尿病黄斑水肿）等，抗 VEGF 注射为主流。
therapeutic_areas.description_en: Retinal disease (wet AMD, diabetic macular edema); anti-VEGF intravitreal injections dominate.

therapeutic_areas.description_zh: 哮喘、COPD 等呼吸系统疾病，吸入制剂与生物制剂并行。
therapeutic_areas.description_en: Asthma, COPD and other respiratory disease; inhaled therapies alongside biologics.

therapeutic_areas.description_zh: 血液肿瘤（白血病、淋巴瘤、骨髓瘤）与血友病等，BTK 抑制剂、CAR-T 集中地。
therapeutic_areas.description_en: Blood cancers (leukemia, lymphoma, myeloma) and hemophilia; a hub for BTK inhibitors and CAR-T.

therapeutic_areas.description_zh: 银屑病、特应性皮炎等，与免疫领域高度重叠。
therapeutic_areas.description_en: Psoriasis, atopic dermatitis and more; heavily overlapping with immunology.

therapeutic_areas.description_zh: 避孕、更年期、子宫内膜异位等女性专科疾病。
therapeutic_areas.description_en: Contraception, menopause, endometriosis and other women's-health conditions.

therapeutic_areas.description_zh: 炎症性肠病、肝病等消化系统疾病。
therapeutic_areas.description_en: Inflammatory bowel disease, liver disease and other GI conditions.

therapeutic_areas.description_zh: 慢性肾病、IgA 肾病等，近年新药密集获批。
therapeutic_areas.description_en: Chronic kidney disease, IgA nephropathy and more; a recent wave of approvals.

therapeutic_areas.description_zh: 心血管疾病治疗，涵盖抗凝、降脂、心衰、高血压等;与心血管代谢领域部分重叠。
therapeutic_areas.description_en: Cardiovascular disease therapeutics — anticoagulation, lipid-lowering, heart failure, hypertension; partially overlaps cardiometabolic.

therapeutic_areas.description_zh: 体外诊断、分子诊断、影像与精准医疗工具,支撑疾病检测与用药决策。
therapeutic_areas.description_en: In-vitro / molecular diagnostics, imaging and precision-medicine tools supporting disease detection and treatment decisions.
